detailed_descriptions.en: I Am Your Beast: Quitting Time is a full story prequel to the hit indie game, set in Southeast Asia. Covert agent Alphonse Harding is a true believer in the power structures of the American military-industrial complex. He believes Colonel Charles Burkin, his handler, has his best interests at heart. He believes fighting a shadow war against a rival of the COI--the Patriotic Defense League--will make the world a better place. He will be proven wrong. Features Fully voiced prequel campaign with 10 brand-new levels. Explore a new biome in Southeast Asia, rendered in the signature style of I Am Your Beast. Chase side objectives while getting the fastest times possible in replayable micro-sandboxes. Tear apart a new NPC faction: the Patriotic Defense League. Throw a riot shield so hard it makes a dude's head explode. Original soundtrack from acclaimed Chicago producer Kalibration (El Paso, Elsewhere 2).

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
I Am Your Beast: Quitting Time is a full story prequel to the hit indie game, set in Southeast Asia.

Covert agent Alphonse Harding is a true believer in the power structures of the American military-industrial complex. He believes Colonel Charles Burkin, his handler, has his best interests at heart. He believes fighting a shadow war against a rival of the COI--the Patriotic Defense League--will make the world a better place.

He will be proven wrong.

Features

  • Fully voiced prequel campaign with 10 brand-new levels.

  • Explore a new biome in Southeast Asia, rendered in the signature style of I Am Your Beast.

  • Chase side objectives while getting the fastest times possible in replayable micro-sandboxes.

  • Tear apart a new NPC faction: the Patriotic Defense League.

  • Throw a riot shield so hard it makes a dude's head explode.

  • Original soundtrack from acclaimed Chicago producer Kalibration (El Paso, Elsewhere 2).
